title: The constant DVR residue-kernel sequence with completed actions
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$ and the specified uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be any scheme with its small pro-etale site [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $m\geq0$ put $C_m=(R/\pi^{m+1})_X$, $B=\lim C_m$, and regard $C_m$ as a $B$-module via its limit projection [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, def-sf-scalar-reduction-categories-restriction]. Let $q_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n$ be the actual constant quotient ring map, regarded as a $B$-module map. There are $B$-linear maps $a_n:C_0\to C_{n+1}$ for all $n\geq0$, taking each constant section represented by $r\in R$ to the section represented by $\pi^{n+1}r$, and the sequences $0\to C_0\xrightarrow{a_n}C_{n+1}\xrightarrow{q_n}C_n\to0$ are short exact in module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

source.place: Tag 0942, lemma-bounded, proof (1), coefficient ideal-quotient triangle; the indicated coefficient or tensor part of its construction

proof.text: Define $R/(\pi)\to R/(\pi^{n+2})$ by $[r]\mapsto[\pi^{n+1}r]$. Changing the representative changes the image by a multiple of $\pi^{n+2}$. The nonzero uniformizer in the domain $R$ can be cancelled, so the map is injective. The quotient onto $R/(\pi^{n+1})$ is onto and its kernel is exactly this image. Multiplication of lifted representatives proves linearity over the middle quotient, with source action through the residue quotient.

Construct the constant module presheaf sectionwise and prove that evaluation preserves its finite limits and colimits. Exact module sheafification gives an exact constant-module functor. Use the already proved generic basisLift comparison and its sheafification-unit equation from ConstantFiniteFreeSectionBasis to identify its quotient-ring modules with restrictions of the constant quotient ring sheaves; this comparison itself requires no freeness hypothesis. Its unit equation fixes the normalization on constant sections.

Restrict along the actual completion projection to the middle quotient. The proved coefficientTower_map identity from CompletedIntegralProjectionDivisibility and limit.w identify the outer scalar actions. The proved generic restrictionComp isomorphism from SuccessiveQuotientFlatTensorSequence has identity underlying maps. Sheafification-unit naturality identifies the transported quotient with strictDvrCoefficientQuotient. Apply the exact composite constant-realization/restriction functor to the elementary short exact sequence and transport along these three normalized comparisons.

theorem strictDvrCoefficientSequence :
    ∃ (a : ∀ n : ℕ, strictDvrFiniteCoefficient l E X 0 ⟶
        strictDvrFiniteCoefficient l E X (n + 1)),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (r : Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E),
        (a n).val.app U
          ((toSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            ((Functor.const X.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
              (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{t + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1))))).app U
                (ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Padic.coefficientExtensionIdeal l E 1) r))) =
          (toSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            ((Functor.const X.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
              (CommRingCat.of
                (ULift.{t + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1 + 1)))))).app U
                  (ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk
                    (Padic.coefficientExtensionIdeal l E (n + 1 + 1))
                    (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E ^ (n + 1) * r)))) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ hz : a n ≫ strictDvrCoefficientQuotient l E X n = 0,
        (ShortComplex.mk (a n) (strictDvrCoefficientQuotient l E X n) hz).ShortExact
